name: Greatoo Intelligent Equipment Inc.
summary: Greatoo Intelligent Equipment Inc. researches and develops, manufactures, and sells tire molds, hydraulic vulcanizing machines, industrial robots, and precision machine tools in China and internationally. It also offers intelligent production lines, tire curing press, and Nc machine tools. The company was formerly known as Greatoo Inc. and changed its name to Greatoo Intelligent Equipment Inc. in October 2015. Greatoo Intelligent Equipment Inc. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Jieyang, China.
